tlsTrust: Self-signed test certificate accepted only by isolated Playwright contexts; TLS encryption remains active.
scope: Single Mac, real Chromium with a fresh persistent receiver profile per trial, loopback HTTP(S) versus original WebRTC. Includes source hashing, storage and verification. Browser RSS is sum of process RSS and may double-count shared pages; 250 ms samples may miss short peaks. CPU from ps cumulative time, includes browser children, may miss processes that exit between samples. Bridge/harness metrics include Playwright orchestration and ps sampling. No claim about physical Wi-Fi, iOS or Pixel throughput.
